segments.name: Factory-built housing
segments.description: Designs and produces factory-built homes sold through independent and Company-owned retailers, community operators and developers.
segments.evidence: See Note 24 to the Consolidated Financial Statements for financial information regarding the Company's business segments, factory-built housing and financial services, which are also discussed below.

segments.name: Financial services
segments.description: Provides mortgage lending and servicing through CountryPlace and property and casualty insurance through Standard Casualty to factory-built home buyers and owners.
segments.evidence: Our finance subsidiary, CountryPlace Acceptance Corp. ("CountryPlace"), is an approved Federal National Mortgage Association ("FNMA" or "Fannie Mae") and Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation ("FHLMC" or "Freddie Mac") seller/servicer, and a Government National Mortgage Association ("GNMA" or "Ginnie Mae") mortgage-backed securities issuer that offers conforming mortgages, non-conforming mortgages and home-only loans to purchasers of factory-built homes.

revenueModel.text: The company earns wholesale revenue from retailers, community operators and developers who order factory-built homes, plus retail sales to home buyers, and interest, loan servicing and insurance premium income from financial services.
revenueModel.evidence: The production schedules for our manufacturing facilities are based on wholesale orders received from independent and Company-owned retailers, planned community operators and residential developers.
